description: This file appears to be a PHP source file defining a controller class for OpenCart's admin interface related to fraud IP management. It includes methods for listing, adding, removing, and managing IPs flagged for fraud detection, as well as lifecycle methods for install/uninstall. The code structure indicates it's part of the backend logic for fraud IP handling within the OpenCart platform.
